description: This Java class implements an event handling strategy for processing ConnectionDeleted events within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging persistence layer. It updates the lifecycle status of a Connection object when a ConnectionDeleted event occurs.

classes.name: ConnectionDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing an event strategy that updates the lifecycle of a Connection object to DELETED when a ConnectionDeleted event is received.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a ConnectionDeleted event by marking the associated Connection's lifecycle as DELETED, returning the updated Connection object or null if the original connection is null.
methods.return: Updated Connection object with lifecycle set to DELETED or null
